PDFEXPORT.SettingTemplatePathHint: Path (in your Foundry Data storage) to your own legally obtained copy of the official fillable D&D 5e character sheet PDF. This file is not included with the module.
PDFEXPORT.SettingProfileHint: Which official PDF form your template file is, so the correct field-name mapping is used.
PDFEXPORT.SettingCustomMapHint: Path to your own field-mapping JSON file, if the bundled mapping doesn't match your PDF's field names. Overrides the edition setting above.
PDFEXPORT.SettingFlattenHint: If enabled, form fields are flattened into static content so the exported PDF can no longer be edited.
PDFEXPORT.ErrorNoTemplate: No PDF template configured. Set a template path in the module settings first.
PDFEXPORT.ErrorTemplateFetch: Could not load the PDF template (HTTP {status}). Check the configured path.
PDFEXPORT.WarnCustomMapFailed: Could not load the custom field-map file, falling back to the bundled mapping.
